name: PT Asuransi Maximus Graha Persada Tbk
summary: PT Asuransi Maximus Graha Persada Tbk engages in the general insurance and reinsurance business in Indonesia. It provides motor vehicle, fire, health, marine cargo, money, and engineering insurance products; and sharia insurance products. The company also offers miscellaneous insurance products comprising burglary, earthquake, personal accident, movable property, workmen's compensation, comprehensive general, product and public liability, professional indemnity, employers' liability, and surety bonds. It operates its insurance business in Sumatera, Java, Bali, Sulawesi, and Kalimantan. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
